title: 第六百零七章 女王陛下的赠礼第六百零六章 争相拉拢
lines: 韦恩闷闷地应了一声。
黄昏大殿是女王陛下的起居之所，除了他们这些在店中当值的人员之外，其他人非请不得擅入。族中那些元老们不方便过来，就只能让他这个贴身侍卫队的成员代劳了。
他从储物空间里取出一个盒子，伸手递给了吴辉。
“这是老祖宗做主给你的，你打开看看吧。”
吴辉摇了摇头，反手把木盒推了回去：“无功不受禄。这礼物太贵重了，我不能收。”
他注意到了韦恩看向木盒时的羡慕和不舍，说明木盒里装的肯定是好东西。
他又不缺这么点东西，可不想因此欠下人情。
要知道，人情债才是最难还的。
谁知，韦恩一听这话却急了。
“给你，你收着就是了！你以潮汐巨人的身份拿下了选拔赛的冠军，给我们整个海巨人一脉争了光，族里给你奖励是应该的。你要是不收，我回去怎么跟老祖宗和长老们交代？”
说着，他竟是直接把木盒硬塞进了吴辉手里，然后一闪身就躲远了，一副“你别想把东西还给我”的架势。
吴辉哭笑不得。
这年头，送礼还有强行送的？
不过，既然是以奖励自己拿冠军为名目给的，他倒是不好拒绝了。
“好吧，我收下就是。”
吴辉无奈地摇了摇头，旋即打开了木盒。
只见木盒里装着的，是一颗湛蓝色的不规则晶体，光泽剔透，正一波又一波的往外散发着浓郁的潮汐之力。
“血脉凝珠！”查理瞪大了眼睛，一脸不敢置信，“海巨人一脉这回可真是下了血本了。”
“这得有拇指大小了吧？”吴辉也有些惊讶，“居然这么大手笔？”
血脉凝珠，顾名思义，这是血脉之力凝结而成的珠子。
这可是难得的好东西。
这是高阶巨人陨落之后，遗骸中残存的血脉之力凝聚而成的能量结晶。
从某种意义上来说，它可以算是巨人的遗蜕。
当然，如今科学已经证明，这血脉凝珠实际上是高纯度能量结晶化的产物，跟尸体并不能等同。但因为它是在巨人遗骸中凝聚出来的，对巨人来说依旧有着非同寻常的意义。
而这拇指大的一颗血脉凝珠，起码也得是十四级以上的巨人才能凝聚出来。整个海巨人一脉恐怕都没几颗。
这份礼物，分量不可谓不重。
【看书福利】关注公众..号【书友大本营】，每天看书抽现金点币!
“哼~不过是一颗血脉凝珠而已。大惊小怪！”见两人惊讶，韦恩就像是得胜的公鸡一样得意地昂起了头，“我海巨人一脉源远流长，好东西有的是呢。”
查理朝他翻了个白眼：“你得瑟个什么劲？又不是你送的。”
content_en:
…
"Yeah."
Wayne responded dully.
The Dusk Hall is the living quarters of Her Majesty the Queen. Except for those of them who are on duty in the store, no one else is allowed to enter without invitation. It was inconvenient for the elders of the clan to come over, so they had to let him, a member of the personal bodyguard, do the work for them.
He took out a box from the storage space and handed it to Wu Hui.
"This is given to you by our ancestors, please open it and take a look."
Wu Hui shook his head and pushed the wooden box back: "No reward for no merit. This gift is too valuable, I can't accept it."
He noticed Wayne's envy and reluctance when he looked at the wooden box, indicating that the wooden box must contain good things.
He doesn't lack such a thing, but he doesn't want to owe a favor because of it.
You know, the debt of gratitude is the most difficult to repay.
Unexpectedly, Wayne became anxious when he heard this.
"Here you go, just keep it! You won the championship as a tide giant and brought glory to our entire sea giant lineage. The clan deserves to reward you. If you don't accept it, how will I explain to my ancestors and elders when I go back?"
As he said that, he forced the wooden box directly into Wu Hui's hand, and then dodged away, with a posture of "Don't even think about returning the things to me."
Wu Hui couldn't laugh or cry.
These days, do you still give gifts by force?
However, since it was given in the name of rewarding himself for winning the championship, it was hard for him to refuse.
"Okay, I'll accept it."
Wu Hui shook his head helplessly and immediately opened the wooden box.
What I saw in the wooden box was a blue irregular crystal with a clear luster, exuding strong tidal power in waves.
"Bloodline Beads!" Charlie's eyes widened with disbelief on his face, "The sea giant lineage has really spent a lot of money this time."
"Isn't this the size of a thumb?" Wu Hui was also a little surprised, "It's so generous?"
Bloodline Beads, as the name suggests, are beads formed by condensation of bloodline power.
This is a rare good thing.
This is the energy crystal formed by condensing the power of the bloodline remaining in the remains after the death of the high-level giant.
In a sense, it can be regarded as the remains of a giant.
Of course, science has now proven that this blood condensation bead is actually the product of high-purity energy crystallization and cannot be equated with a corpse. But because it was condensed from the giant's remains, it still has extraordinary significance to the giant.
And this blood condensation bead as big as a thumb can only be condensed by a giant of at least level fourteen. The entire line of sea giants probably only has a few.
This gift is of great weight.

"Hmph~ It's just a blood bead. What a fuss!" Seeing the two of them surprised, Wayne raised his head proudly like a victorious rooster, "I have a long lineage of sea giants, and I have a lot of good things."
Charlie rolled his eyes at him: "What do you have to do? It's not like you gave it to me."
